all saints day: sunday next november 1st is the feast day of all saints, masses at the usual sunday times. vigil saturday at 6.30pm & sunday 10am, 11.15am & 12.30pm. altar servers : we are recruiting girls and boys from 3rd and 4th class, to act as altar servers. first training session will take place on saturday, november 7th at 5.45pm for 40 minutes in the church before vigil mass and to stay for mass at 6. 30pm. forms are being distributed to local schools but we welcome any boy or girl interested to come along on the first training evening with a parent or guardian. mass bookings 2027: we are now taking bookings for masses for 2027. bookings can be made at the parish office a nd the offering given at the time of booking the mass. the offering for the shared mass saturday 6.30pm and sunday 10am is €10, (1 name / family with 1 address.) individual masses weekdays mon – sat. 9.30am & sunday 11.15am & 12.30pm is €20. thank you for your co-operation. university hospital kerry: invite you and your family to the annual november mass for all those who have died in the hospital over the past year, including those who have died in palliative care services, maternity services, relatives of hos pital staff and former staff members of university hospital kerry. the mass will be celebrated in st. johns church, castle street on monday november 2nd at 7pm. all welcome. recovery haven: free 6 week online course ” building better caregivers ” starts monday november 2nd 10.30am - 1pm. for more information, call
